unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 12 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.4 - THEME 3: PERSONAL LIFE & WELL-BEING

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will design a project titled ''Technology and Its Impact on Daily Life'', focusing on how technology influences their personal experiences. They will organise a debate panel where each student takes the role of an expert, critic, or neutral observer. Each panel member will prepare arguments about different aspects of technology such as supporters: discuss how technology improves productivity, communication, and efficiency; critics: talk about privacy issues, hidden digital patterns, and unreliable information; neutral experts: explain how technology organises data, anticipates needs, and influences decision-making. Through research and discussion, students will analyse, argue, and debate by helping them develop critical thinking and communication skills while reflecting on the advantages and challenges of technology in their lives. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''personal life and well-being with its components such as technology (AI) and its impact on daily life; dealing with burnout and staying motivated'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in after prep year 12 of upper secondary school may know what technology (AI) and its impact on daily life; dealing with burnout and staying motivated mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in after prep year 12 of upper secondary school of an upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''personal life and well-being'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year, and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in after prep year 12 of upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''personal life and well-being with its components such as technology (AI) and its impact on daily life; dealing with burnout and staying motivated'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To reflect more deeply on the emotional and practical challenges faced by AI assistants and how they manage responsibilities in English. Activity 1: Journal Writing from the Perspective of an AI Assistant Students compose a detailed journal entry from the perspective of an AI assistant, addressing both functional and emotional challenges. They use the target vocabulary such as ''intervention, accountability, and anticipation'' and use verbs such as ''to handle, to encourage, and to operate'' to enrich their writing. After completing their entries, students form small groups to share their work and discuss the emotional and practical aspects they have addressed. The teacher gives constructive feedback on the use of the target language including grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary by focussing on both linguistic accuracy and creative expression. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To understand the role of AI assistants in daily interactions with students, teachers, and families while using target vocabulary to describe emotional and functional experiences in English. Activity 1: Diary Writing from the Perspective of an AI Assistant Students individually write a journal entry from the perspective of an AI assistant. They begin with a template that includes sentence starters such as: Date: _______________ Dear Journal, Today, I helped someone by... Sometimes, I feel... My favourite part about being an assistant is... However, I don’t enjoy... I often handle tasks such as... My role also involves... After completing their entries, students work in pairs to share and discuss their writing, focusing on how they used the target vocabulary and reflecting on the role of AI assistant. The teacher provides feedback on the use of the target language including grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary, by giving suggestions for improvement where needed. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
